note: The input P2P Group Info attribute length is accepted from the vendor IE and stored for later group client parsing.
The candidate descriptor supplies the Number of Secondary Device Types byte as 28, making the parsed client advertise 224 bytes of secondary device type data.
The parser checks only that the descriptor contains 8 bytes per advertised secondary device type, not that the count fits the destination WPS secondary-device-type array.
The oversized count is copied into the parsed p2p_client_info structure and remains associated with cli->sec_dev_types.
The oversized parsed count is converted to a 224-byte copy length for the fixed-size peer info destination.
The 224-byte copy writes past the 128-byte wps_sec_dev_type_list array in struct p2p_peer_info, corrupting following pointer fields in struct p2p_device.
